name: What can go wrong when refreshing a foreclosed kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when refreshing a foreclosed kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are hidden water damage, mold, bad wiring, pest activity, and spoiled food or hazardous materials left in cabinets or appliances. In a foreclosed kitchen, skipping inspection or cleanup can lead to health issues, inspection delays, and repairs that cost more later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden leaks, mold, bad wiring, pests, and unsafe leftovers are the main risks. If you skip inspection or cleanup, small problems can turn into expensive repairs.
